name: Tile Mass Rewriter
description: Replaces all tiles with a specified value across the entire area.

fields.name: Old Tile Value
fields.description: The tile value to search for and replace.

fields.name: New Tile Value
fields.description: The tile value to use as a replacement.

fields.name: Enable Sound Effect
fields.description: Enables the sound-processing call after a successful tile replacement. The audible effect is unconfirmed.

fields.name: Enable Dust Effect
fields.description: Creates a dust effect when a tile is replaced.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable that activates the tile replacement.
